title: Geometric regularity descends from a directed colimit of subfields to the field
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: If a field k is a directed colimit of subfields k_i and an algebra A is geometrically regular over each k_i, the lemma concludes that A is geometrically regular over k (statement lines 47418-47424). The proof does not work with the definition directly over all field extensions: it reduces to a finite purely inseparable extension k', observes that such an extension is described by finitely many generators and relations and therefore occurs already over some k_i, and then identifies the two base changes (proof lines 47426-47433). Moving finite data down the directed colimit is the step that carries the content, and the author writes it out; the text is copied verbatim including its wording about the two extensions. H2.
